scope: Independent source review and targeted native repros; no Android device execution

fixes.issue: Android window mutations from native worker thread
fixes.implementation: SurfaceActivity.java owns immersive Window/View operations on Android UI lifecycle thread; nativeDimensions only writes atomic dimensions.
fixes.verification: Cross-compilation; static JNI symbol and package inspection; runtime gate remains open.

fixes.issue: Checkpoint initialization exception could terminate worker process
fixes.implementation: EngineService initializes inside exception boundary and reports unavailable checkpoint directory without std::terminate.
fixes.verification: test_engine plus review child repro: child signaled=0 signal=0.

fixes.issue: Stop could discard accepted paint or final state
fixes.implementation: Closing mode drains the accepted FIFO and commits a final checkpoint within bounded graceful shutdown.
fixes.verification: test_engine reopens state after shutdown and checks accepted paint.

fixes.issue: Retired delayed writer could publish after replacement
fixes.implementation: Durable owner lease checked under the publication lock, separate from state generation; cancellation checked after initialization.
fixes.verification: test_checkpoint stale-owner and cross-process cases; review repro exists at stop=0 exists after stop=0.

fixes.issue: Export could return stale renderer snapshot
fixes.implementation: FIFO barrier returns the accepted session after prior commands; Android waits at most 900 ms and refuses an unacknowledged export.
fixes.verification: test_engine acknowledged export ordering and test_session SHA256 corruption rejection.

fixes.issue: Latest mode could reinterpret earlier queued stroke
fixes.implementation: Paint and View commands share ordered queue.
fixes.verification: test_engine compares queued mode/paint with sequential reference.

fixes.issue: Centered pinch could be mistaken for two-finger tap
fixes.implementation: Gesture travel includes change in pinch distance as well as centroid motion.
fixes.verification: test_input stationary-centroid pinch exceeds tap movement threshold.

remaining_boundaries: No Android device or emulator; touch/lifecycle/audio/export handlers require device validation.
C++ cannot safely force-kill a blocked thread; independent host supervision is process-based.
Saved modeled session excludes accumulated renderer tracer history and active acoustic oscillator phase.
A checkpoint depends on successful filesystem flush and rename; whole-host loss is outside in-process guarantee.
